topics.blurb: The Syrian civil war from the 2011 protests to the fall of the Assad government, assembled from thirty-two per-period timeline articles.
topics.note: 21 meetings is a limit of the matching rule, not a measure of Council activity on Syria. Most Syria votes are filed under the generic heading The situation in the Middle East, which also covers Lebanon, UNIFIL and the Golan. That heading is not matched automatically — attaching the Syrian chronology to a meeting about UNIFIL would be worse than attaching nothing — so the Middle East meetings here were attached one by one, and the rest are not counted.
